VALUES 
('Making My SCR Debut: Million Dollar Quartet (2025)', 'million-dollar-quartet-scr-debut', 'Co-designing my first production at South Coast Repertory, one of the nation''s leading regional theaters.', '2025-08-29', NULL, 'published', FALSE, '2025-08-29', NOW(), NOW()),
('Assisting Tom Buderwitz on The Play That Goes Wrong at Seattle Rep', 'assisting-the-play-that-goes-wrong', 'Working with Tom Buderwitz on this hilarious comedy at Seattle Repertory Theatre.', '2025-08-28', NULL, 'published', FALSE, '2025-08-28', NOW(), NOW()),
('40 Productions at Okoboji Summer Theatre', '40-productions-at-okoboji-summer-theatre', 'Celebrating a milestone: my 40th scenic design for Okoboji Summer Theatre.', '2025-08-06', NULL, 'published', FALSE, '2025-08-06', NOW(), NOW()),
('Fifth Season Assisting Jo Winiarski — Utah Shakespeare Festival', 'fifth-season-utah-shakespeare-festival', 'Returning for my fifth season as assistant scenic designer at Utah Shakespeare Festival.', '2025-06-27', NULL, 'published', FALSE, '2025-06-27', NOW(), NOW()),
